about: VERIFY V2: why each region over dE 6 is over. Rules are matched in order on '<capture id>' and '<region name>' (fnmatch globs; 'lang' optional). type finding = a defect with an owner in the V2 findings list (F-nn, field 'ref'; V2 returned the list in its report for build/compare/FINDINGS.md); type exception = an explained, expected difference (field 'why'). Generated by build/v2/make_annotations.py after looking at every build/compare/sbs sheet. tools/compare/summarize.py fails when an over-6 region has no rule.
